title: Cameras software versions MV 7.3.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Recommended Release MV Cameras firmware is now available

New: Added support for Cross Camera Tracking
Bug fixes: Resolved an issue where some services could restart unexpectedly
Improved performance and reliability for MV84X cameras
Resolved an issue where Video Clip API could fail to respond
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15
MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches

html:
Cameras software versions MV 7.3.1 changelog

New

  • Added support for Cross Camera Tracking

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue where some services could restart unexpectedly

  • Improved performance and reliability for MV84X cameras

  • Resolved an issue where Video Clip API could fail to respond

General

  • Enhanced database reliability and efficiency

  • General stability and performance improvements

  • Improved object detection performance

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15

  • MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches
